messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — v1.6.0 code freeze goes into effect TOMORROW 18:00 UTC. After 18:00 only emergency/security fixes or approved late-merge exceptions. Please get non-blocking, non-release-critical PRs merged today. :warning:
release-bot: Reminder scheduled — v1.6.0 freeze window starts 2026-11-05 18:00 UTC. Submit exceptions via the late-merge form: https://redwood/internals/late-merge.
jordan: Question — I have a dependency bump (libkv 2.4.1 -> 2.4.2) in my PR that fixes a noisy warn but may touch startup ordering. Is that considered emergency?
maria: Not emergency. If it can wait, please target main (post-release). If you think it's safe, open a PR against release/v1.6 with clear test plan and mention me. We prefer patches that are strictly non-functional for the release branch.
kevin: I have a small perf fix that regressed tail latency in canary. PR is #4923. Would like late-merge permission — it's a single-file change and has a rollback patch ready.
sara: Are docs-only PRs allowed after freeze? I have a tiny wording tweak for the install guide.
maria: Docs-only are allowed in practice until freeze. After freeze, docs-only still should avoid changing code paths; if it's purely text go ahead during the cutoff window, but please label as docs-only and include a short QA checklist. If in doubt, file an exception.
jordan: QA headcount: we only have two folks available to validate release branch from 09:00-12:00 UTC tomorrow. If you need manual sign-off, note it in the PR and prioritize accordingly. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: PR #4923 link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4923. Rollback: revert commit abc1234. Smoke test I ran:
```
# smoke test
make smoke && ./bin/e2e --smoke --timeout 120
```
Unit and integration tests green on CI. Will prepare a short test matrix and ping QA.
maria: Ok — submit the late-merge form (https://redwood/internals/late-merge) and include the rollback command, test matrix, and who will own the post-merge monitor. Also add the label `release/exception` to the PR. We'll triage exceptions at 10:30 UTC tomorrow.
release-bot: Late-merge request received from @kevin for PR #4923 — token id 7f3b. Scheduled for triage 2026-11-05 10:30 UTC.
kevin: Submitted form and added label. Tagging @jordan for any integration concerns.
sara: tiny docs PR is #4927 — purely markdown, no build changes. I tagged it docs-only and added changelog note. If docs-only is fine, I'll merge before freeze.
maria: Sounds good. Last reminder: if you're planning any branch cuts or version bumps, push them today and ping here. After freeze we only accept critical fixes with a rollback plan, tests, and QA owner. Thanks all — please prioritize merges accordingly. :thumbsup:
